newsitem.title: USA: Smithfield sees Q1 exceeding yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Smithfield sees Q1 exceeding yr-ago.

text.p: Smithfield Foods Inc said Wednesday that based on stronger than expected May results, it expects fiscal 1998 first quarter earnings to show a "substantial" increase from a year earlier.
The company today reported higher sales and earnings for the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter and full year.

Smithfield said fiscal 1998 results should benefit from larger hog numbers resulting from a substantial drop in corn prices during the last year. International sales should benefit from curtailment of pork exports from Taiwan to Japan because of disease in the Taiwanese herd, it said.
Smithfield Foods earned $746,000, or $0.02 a share, in the year-ago first quarter.
The company said sharply improved results for processed meats, along with substantially increased profitability at its hog production group, led to the strong fiscal 1997 earnings performance.
